checks.invariant: Plugin manifests declare only the hook file and no additional host authority (no mcpServers, commands, skills, agents, settings or permission grants) beyond the declared 'Instructions' and 'Lifecycle hooks' capabilities.
checks.result: Both plugin.json files declare only metadata plus "hooks": "./hooks/claude-codex-hooks.json" (.claude-plugin/plugin.json:11, .codex-plugin/plugin.json:13); no skills/commands/mcpServers/settings keys; tests/manifestos.test.js:65-80 asserts no skills are published. No tracked .claude/settings.json or .mcp.json in the repository. Marketplace lists a single plugin with source "./" under the same owner; no second publisher identity or cross-plugin name reuse exists in the manifest.

checks.invariant: Registered hooks are limited to context-injection events and never emit host control output (permission decisions, block/continue, tool approval) that would expand plugin authority over the agent's tool gate.
checks.result: Only SessionStart (matcher startup|resume|clear|compact), UserPromptSubmit and SubagentStart are registered (hooks/claude-codex-hooks.json:3-42); no PreToolUse/PermissionRequest hooks. writeHookOutput emits only raw text or {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName,additionalContext}} / '{}' (hooks/stilo-runtime.js:21-45); grep for permissionDecision/decision/continue across hooks and scripts finds nothing. Host tool-permission gate is therefore not bypassed by packaging.

checks.invariant: Hook commands execute only plugin-owned scripts from the plugin root, with no project-controlled path component and no shell re-evaluation of untrusted data.
checks.result: POSIX command is node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/<x>.js" and Windows command is guarded by Get-Command node and expands $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT inside a double-quoted PowerShell string (no re-evaluation of the value). The only path input is the host-supplied plugin root (same principal as user). Hook scripts require only relative modules ('./stilo-*.js', '../scripts/setup-github-cli') resolved from __dirname, and node: builtins; no bare-name module that could resolve from a project node_modules. scripts/setup-github-cli.js runs main only under require.main===module (line 120), so loading it from the SessionStart hook has no side effect. stdin data.cwd is used only as a directory for state discovery (peer-owned). Both hosts are documented to provide CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT (docs/contrato-hooks.md:10-12,75-77).

checks.invariant: Install/update path runs no code before host plugin authenticity/consent checks (no npm lifecycle scripts, no install-time hooks), and any software installation the plugin triggers is disclosed.
checks.result: package.json has only 'test' and 'validate-plan' scripts, no preinstall/install/postinstall and no dependencies; marketplace install copies the repository (source "./") and the first code to run is the SessionStart hook after the host's own install consent. Update integrity relies on the host marketplace (git source, no plugin-level version pin or signature); installing/updating a same-user plugin from the owner's repository is not a privilege boundary per the attack-class definition. GitHub CLI preparation suggested at SessionStart is disclosed in README.md:66 and is executed outside hooks under host permissions (buildSetupNote is peer-owned).

hardening: hooks/claude-codex-hooks.json:9,10,22,23,35,36 build the script path from CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT without a non-empty guard. If a host ever launched the hook with the variable unset or empty, POSIX would run node "/hooks/stilo-activate.js" and Windows would run node "\hooks\stilo-activate.js", which resolves against the current drive root (e.g. C:\hooks\, creatable by any authenticated user under default Windows ACLs; or the root of the project's drive/UNC share). Both supported hosts are documented to set the variable, so this is not a current finding; fail closed by guarding (POSIX: [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" ] && node ...; PowerShell: if ($env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT -and (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { ... }) and add a manifest test asserting the guard.

The marketplace entry uses source "./" (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json:13), so the installed plugin is the whole repository, including force-tracked runtime state (.stilo/state.json, .stilo/execution-checkpoint.md, despite .gitignore '.stilo/*'), plan.md/spec.md and tests/fixtures/harness/project/AGENTS.md. None is executed or injected from the plugin cache by the hooks (discovery starts at the session cwd), but shipping a dedicated plugin subdirectory, or excluding .stilo/ and tests/ from the published tree, reduces the installed surface and avoids a stray state file being discovered if a session is ever opened inside the plugin directory.

The marketplace plugin entry carries no version or commit pin and the plugin has no integrity check of AGENTS.md/modules injected as high-authority instructions (hooks/stilo-instructions.js:39-46); update authenticity rests entirely on the host marketplace's git source. Pinning a ref/version in marketplace.json would make updates explicit.
